name: gizeh
description: gizeh — Cairo für Touristen. Einfache Vektorgrafik-Bibliothek auf Basis von cairocffi. Surface/PDFSurface, 10 Shape-Funktionen (circle, rectangle, square, arc, polyline, regular_polygon, bezier_curve, ellipse, star, text), immutable Transformationen (rotate/translate/scale), ColorGradient, ImagePattern, Group. MoviePy-kompatibel für Animationen.
author: Zulko et al. (Open Source)
covers: Surface(width, height, bg_color) — Zeichenfläche, PNG/numpy Export
circle(r, xy, fill, stroke, stroke_width, angle)
rectangle(lx, ly, xy, fill, stroke, stroke_width, angle)
square(l, xy, fill, stroke, stroke_width, angle)
arc(r, a1, a2, xy, fill, stroke, stroke_width)
regular_polygon(r, n, angle, xy, fill, stroke, stroke_width)
ellipse(rx, ry, xy, fill, stroke, stroke_width, angle)
star(r1, r2, n, xy, fill, stroke, stroke_width, angle)
text(txt, fontfamily, fontsize, fill, xy, angle, h_align, v_align)
Element.rotate(angle, center) / translate(xy) / scale(rx, ry, center) — immutable
ColorGradient(type, begin, end, stops_colors) — linear + radial
